title: Tropical Aero — Frutiger Vista Serenity
description: Hyper-saturated nature photography meets Windows Vista's Frutiger-Aero aesthetic: glossy 3D bubbles drift across tropical aqua and leaf-green, anchored by a single rounded-glass headline panel carrying a soft inner-glow wellness phrase.
philosophy: This template is rooted in the utopian optimism of mid-2000s digital design — the era that sincerely believed technology and nature could merge into glossy, luminous harmony. It refuses flatness, dark irony, and the spartan minimalism that swept in after the Vista moment faded. Every surface catches a soft inner light; every element floats rather than sits. It exists for the speaker whose single line of copy deserves to feel like a Windows Vista screensaver you never wanted to close.
goodFor: Single-line wellness or mindfulness affirmation title slides
Lifestyle and health brand identity reveal moments
Looping ambient display screens in spas or yoga studios
Nostalgic-digital opening cards for nature-forward decks
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly financial or sales reviews
Multi-column data comparison and KPI dashboards
Dense academic citations or research paper presentations
Dark-themed enterprise security or cyberpunk pitch decks
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide channels the earnest techno-optimism of mid-2000s digital design — luminous, floating, sincerely beautiful. A lush tropical photograph bleeds edge to edge, its greens and aquas softened by a rounded glass panel cradling the headline in a warm inner glow. Glossy spheres with specular highlights drift like dewdrops across the scene, everything weightless and airborne. Avoid flatness, geometric severity, or any trace of post-2010 spartan minimalism — every surface here shimmers.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed tropical photography occupies the entire canvas edge-to-edge with no outer margin. A centered rounded-rectangle glass panel sits at golden-ratio vertical placement, spanning the inner two-thirds of the slide width, and holds a single headline line. Glossy translucent spheres are scattered asymmetrically — larger forms near the lower-left and upper-right corners, smaller ones drifting mid-frame — without overlapping the headline panel. No header band; a minimal deck-identity mark sits at bottom-center with generous vertical breathing room below the glass panel.

examples.promptCore: Every element floats as a luminous glass object above tropical foliage, soft inner highlights glowing against the saturated backdrop — pure Vista-era utopia. Composition is airy and modular: a central frosted panel breathes at center while glossy pill cards cluster loosely below it, like soap bubbles in still air. Warm tropical color saturates through every glass surface; mood is sincerely utopian and hyper-chromatic. Avoid flatness, hard edges, dark overlay washes, or any minimalist restraint.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed tropical nature photograph as background layer; 12-column grid with roughly 9% outer margins. A primary rounded-glass panel occupies cols 2–11, vertically centered with a slight upward bias, carrying the main content text. Two to three secondary items render as glossy pill-shaped cards floating in a loose horizontal cluster below (cols 3–5, 5–7, 7–9), each with a soft drop shadow and a visible breathing gap separating them from the panel above. Page number anchored bottom-right outside all panel zones; no header band or horizontal rule dividers.
